# TrueYouTeller

> Free personality test that tells you which of the 16 personality types you are, plus your spirit animal. No sign-up, instant results, about 10 minutes. Also offers fun character quizzes, a type compatibility checker and personality games to play with friends.

## Main pages

- [Personality test](https://www.trueyouteller.com/test): Rate 48 statements (classic or scenario mode) to get your 16-type result and spirit animal
- [All 16 personality types](https://www.trueyouteller.com/types): Overview of every personality type
- [Compatibility checker](https://www.trueyouteller.com/compatibility): How any two of the 16 types get along in love, friendship and work
- [Play with friends](https://www.trueyouteller.com/play): See how friends see you, let them guess your type, compare as a couple or best friends, and map a group's personalities
- [Fun quizzes](https://www.trueyouteller.com/quizzes): Short themed personality quizzes
